note: Round 16 drafts awaiting the lead's veto (lead gate 1). Never loaded by the game; the CLI measures them with --extra-lines.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Smoke from one end of the floor to the other! Nobody saw all of that!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Look at that floor! It's a scrapyard already!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Boom, boom, boom! They're dropping all over the place!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: That's a pile-up! Wreck on top of wreck!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: The whole floor just lit up! We'll count them later, folks!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Half the arena is burning, and nobody is slowing down!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: The replay crew is going to need a week for that one!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: That's carnage! Absolute carnage on the floor!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: That all happened in about three seconds, folks!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Can somebody upstairs keep count? Because I can't!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I looked down at my notes and missed half of it!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Every corner of this building just went up at once!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Another one! They're picking them off one at a time!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Make it two! They are not letting up!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Before the smoke even clears, there goes another!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Again! They went right back to work!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: One more on the pile! They are hunting now!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: And that's the follow-up! Beautiful!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Oh, they're not done! Another one goes up!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Right on the heels of the last one! There goes another!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Don't look away, folks! They just got another!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Two in quick succession! This crowd is losing its mind!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: They saw the first one go down and went straight for the next!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Same side, same story! Another vehicle is finished!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Nobody is answering back! This is one-way traffic!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Still nothing coming back! They're running this floor!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Another one, and still not a scratch on their side!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: They own this floor right now! Nobody can touch them!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Kill after kill, and the other side has no reply!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: How long can this go on? They just keep taking them out!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: That's a statement! Over and over, and no answer!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Somebody call a timeout, because this is getting ugly!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: They are rolling downhill, and nobody is in the way!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: This is the stretch people will be talking about tomorrow!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Wait, look at this!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hang on, hang on!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Oh! Look out!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hey, hey, look down there!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Stop, stop, look at this!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Oh, here we go!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Excuse me, look at this!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Wait a second!
